results.title: IT Security Policy
results.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and rotated every 90 days. Laptops lock automatically after 10 minutes of inactivity. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT within 24 hours. VPN sessions expire after 12 hours.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.text: Full-time employees accrue 22 days of paid annual leave per year, plus 10 days of sick leave. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over to the next calendar year. Parental leave is 26 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers.

results.title: Remote Work Policy
